art_instructions: Render a sunny Greek village school exterior from a child’s low viewpoint, looking up at a small white‑washed building with Mediterranean blue wooden trim and a terracotta tile roof. Center the facade so it fills the frame; a short wooden‑columned porch sits below, with a natural stone path leading in from the bottom foreground, an olive tree on the left, and a bougainvillea trellis on the right. Place Glaux the owl (chibi proportions) landing on top of the roof ridge slightly right of center: wings still half‑open in a gentle braking pose, talons just touching a curved tile, green scarf fluttering as the saturated accent, and a tiny cross‑body satchel snug against her cream‑and‑brown feathers. Her expression is happy and focused (big round amber eyes, tiny smile), showing she has just arrived; suggest motion with 2–3 small curved motion lines near one wing and a lightly tilted feather or two—keep it soft and cute. Keep her about 1/6 of the frame height so the school clearly reads as the setting, with the roof edge high in the composition. In the background, hint at the playground with a simple blue swing frame peeking beyond the right edge of the building and a low stone bird bath near the porch; keep forms simple and pastel. Lighting is bright, soft midday sun with minimal cel‑shading and a faint warm occlusion under roof tiles and porch beam; lines are clean monoline in dark brown. No text anywhere, and fill the image fully with the building, garden shapes, and a pale sky gradient.
